name: mfonte/secure-image-converter
description: Turns untrusted images into web-optimised WEBP and AVIF files with input validation, isolated decoding and output verification.

suggest.ext-posix: Needed for the process, rlimit and sandbox isolation levels: kills the whole process group on timeout and checks the owner of the isolation cache.

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan at level max as PHP 7.2.5 and as PHP 8.5 (needs tools/phpstan).
scripts-descriptions.cs:check: Report coding style violations as a diff, without changing files (needs tools/php-cs-fixer).
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Fix coding style violations in place (needs tools/php-cs-fixer).
scripts-descriptions.ci: Run cs:check, analyse and test, in this order.
